items.name: Pyraminx in Pewaukee 2025
items.information:
This is the 3rd annual Pyraminx in Pewaukee! We are excited to see many new and returning faces here in Pewuakee again!
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTcxMzMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--de1b919a3a0e545e80b1abeefb9d145d97c5b6d4/pke2025-small.jpg)

New to competing? This competition is a good one to be your first!

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a6239c56608b03fda2194e41dd545ce91819975d/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)

items.name: Mahalo iā Maui 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png)
### Come join us for our annual WCA competition on the beautiful island of Maui!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.
